content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal provide user-friendly interfaces and integrations for selling digital products. However, their reach is limited, with Stripe accessible in just 46 out of 195 countries. PayPal, while more widespread, still imposes account suspensions that can freeze funds for up to 180 days, often without recourse. This can severely impact a creator's cash flow and ability to access their earnings. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a permanent solution where you control everything — from payment processing to product delivery — without depending on restrictive platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have stringent policies that exclude many countries, effectively leaving creators without viable options. While some may resort to workarounds, these are often unreliable and temporary. For instance, PayPal's regulations can lead to account limitations or freezes, causing significant disruptions. Whereas, sovereign commerce stacks like COREMERCH are built to empower creators from these restricted areas by providing a robust infrastructure that requires no reliance on traditional payment processors. This means that creators can conduct business freely and securely, independent of geographical barriers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed is another critical differentiator. With traditional platforms, delays in fund availability can be frustrating. Stripe often takes time to settle transactions, while PayPal can complicate the process further through account checks. On the other hand, platforms like NOWPayments integrated into the COREMERCH stack offer automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with fees as low as 0.5%. This means instant access to funds with minimal costs, allowing creators to reinvest in their businesses without unnecessary delays or hidden fees.
Sovereign infrastructure means you own everything; no rent, no restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a crucial factor when comparing these options. With Stripe and PayPal, creators are essentially renting a service, which can be revoked at any time. In contrast, COREMERCH provides full ownership of the infrastructure after deployment. You are the sole owner of your products and customer data. Additionally, the automation of payment processing and product delivery through tools like Cloudflare Workers ensures a seamless experience for both creators and customers. This level of control and reliability is simply unmatched in conventional platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you plan to sell a few digital products and want something simple, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a solid choice. However, for those aiming for a more robust setup with multiple products, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. Deployed within 48 hours and fully tested, it ensures that your digital store is up and running quickly, allowing you to focus on your craft rather than technical hurdles. This architecture is tailored for creators who value speed, efficiency, and control.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Payment delays and freezes are a thing of the past with automated crypto processing.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
